notes.title: Metal: Hellsinger VR Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
Hellsingers, 

The fires are burning bright in the Eight Hells today!  

[b]We’re incredibly excited to announce that on October 3, you will embody the demon unlike ever before. [/b]

Metal: Hellsinger VR redesigns the original acclaimed rhythm shooter from the ground up, placing its infernal arsenal straight into your hands and the fires of Hell at your feet. Experience an unparallelled state of flow as you move, dash, and aim in full VR.   

[b]Headbang into the Hells in our new trailer: [/b]

[previewyoutube=4KdD8-ZS81c;full][/previewyoutube]
Metal: Hellsinger VR features the full multi award-winning soundtrack performed by metal legends such as Serj Tankian (System of a Down), Matt Heafy (Trivium), and Alissa White-Gluz (Arch Enemy). 

The Dream of the Beast DLC will also arrive at launch, which includes two additional songs, performed by Cristina Scabbia (Lacuna Coil) and Will Ramos (Lorna Shore), as well as The Red Right Hand, an infernal weapon which fires in rhythmic bursts. Also included in the DLC are three outfits which each comes with an alternate default passive effect, such as the ability to increase your weapon’s max ammo each time you successfully Quick Reload. 

Get ready to show the Hells the meaning of metal as you embark on an epic campaign of revenge to take back your voice from the Red Judge of the Eight Hells.
